post.summary: Add a LaTeX version to a document
post.description: Stores LaTeX source as a new immutable version and queues PDF compilation with the given template version (its .cls and other files sit next to the source). Without `templateVersionId`, the latest version of the template this document used last is taken, or of the template providing the `\documentclass`; pass null to compile without a template. Typical flow for tailoring: read the main resume version with readDocumentVersion, edit the source, create a tailored document and add the edited source here. Poll getDocumentVersion for `compileStatus`.
